invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieRestoreMetadata object from execute(); unless execute() can return null, this should hold.
context is passed in as a parameter and is used in the construction of MergeOnReadRestoreActionExecutor, so it should not be null.
restoreInstantTimestamp is passed to executor and likely required to identify the restore operation.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp is passed to executor and likely required for restore operation.
